methods.name: createApplication
methods.desc: Sets the manager to the creator. Bare create, called once at deployment.

methods.name: prepare
methods.desc:
Begin bootstrapping: hand the pool over to  and reset asset state.


Called by the Factory (still the manager at this point). The admin then fills
the pool with one or more  batches and closes it with
. Batching keeps each transaction's resource
references within the per-group limit, so the pool can hold many assets.

args.name: admin
args.desc: account that becomes the pool manager.

methods.name: addAssets
methods.desc:
Append a batch of assets and weights during bootstrap. Manager-only, and only
before . May be called repeatedly; AssetIDs must be
strictly increasing across all batches. Weights accumulate and are validated
at finalize.

args.name: assets
args.desc: ASA IDs for this batch (strictly increasing).

methods.name: finalizeBootstrap
methods.desc:
Close bootstrapping: require the weights to sum to SCALE and mint the LP token.
The pool is live (accepts liquidity) afterwards. Manager-only.

methods.name: addLiquidity
methods.desc:
Deposit one asset toward a liquidity position. The amount is held in 
until  converts the full position into LP tokens.

args.name: index
args.desc: index of the deposited asset in the pool.

methods.name: getLiquidity
methods.desc:
Mint LP tokens for the sender's pending deposits, then clear them.


The first provider receives a fixed amount (AMOUNT_LP_DEPLOYER) and must seed
every asset. Subsequent providers receive an amount proportional to the value
they add, via .

returns.desc: the amount of LP tokens minted.

methods.name: burnLiquidity
methods.desc: Burn LP tokens and return the holder's proportional share of every asset.

args.name: transferTxn
args.desc: LP transfer into the pool; its amount is the LP burned.

methods.name: swap
methods.desc:
Swap  for  along the weighted constant-mean curve.


The input asset is sent into the pool, the output asset back to the sender.
Reverts if the computed output is below  (slippage guard).

args.name: transferTxn
args.desc: asset transfer carrying the input amount.

returns.desc: the output amount sent to the sender.

methods.name: changeWeights
methods.desc:
Change the pool's weights. Manager-only; rejected while a transition is active.


With  the new weights apply immediately. Otherwise they
interpolate linearly from the current weights to  over 
blocks; during the transition  returns the live value.

args.name: newWeights
args.desc: target weight per asset (each = MIN_WEIGHT, summing to SCALE).

returns.desc: the round at which the transition ends (0 if instant).

methods.name: getCurrentWeight
methods.desc: Current weight of an asset, interpolated if a weight transition is active.
